summary: 58-minute committee debrief. Entered split: Priya/Sara strong-hire-L6, Diego hire-L6, Rohan hire-L5, Nathan lean-no-hire. Two pivots resolved the disagreement: (1) Sara argued the cost of NOT hiring (8-month rebuild slip) outweighed the marginal risk of hiring; (2) Diego pointed out that down-leveling to L5 would block Alex from leading the cross-team rebuild, so the leveling decision was constrained by role need. Outcome: hire at L6, conditional on reference and structured six-month review. Comp at median of band ($320k base) given logged dissents.
